subject: Elementary Literacy Program Selection
overview: The Committee approved the selection of a new district-wide elementary literacy curriculum and reviewed comprehensive data from youth health and academic growth assessments. They also discussed recommendations for updating the health curriculum and approved the meeting schedule for the next academic year.

items.title: Consent Agenda and Subcommittee Minutes
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda and minutes from the June 1 evaluation subcommittee meeting.

items.title: Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Dr. Edouard-Vincent reported on investigations into a Pride Month vandalism incident at the high school and recognized upcoming graduation and promotion ceremonies across the district.

items.title: Communities That Care Survey Presentation
items.summary: Penny Funaiole presented 2021 survey data on youth substance use and mental health, highlighting that local usage rates are generally below national averages while noting concerns regarding vaping and social media impact.

items.title: NWEA MAP Academic Growth Report
items.summary: Staff presented year-end assessment data showing significant literacy growth in first grade and identified secondary math and reading as areas for continued data-driven intervention.

items.title: Selection of Elementary Literacy Program
items.summary: The Committee approved the adoption of Houghton Mifflin Harcourt's "Into Reading" as the new district-wide elementary literacy curriculum following a multi-year review process.

items.title: HECAT Health Curriculum Review
items.summary: The Committee reviewed recommendations to update the sexual health curriculum with inclusive, medically accurate content and to integrate health education into elementary grades.

items.title: High School Panorama Survey Report
items.summary: Dr. Cushing provided an overview of preliminary student survey data regarding school climate, safety, and belonging at the high school level.

items.title: 2023-2024 School Committee Meeting Calendar
items.summary: The Committee approved the meeting schedule for the upcoming academic year, including a modified January 2024 calendar to facilitate the onboarding of new members.

items.title: Student Advisory Committee Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution requiring the administration to develop a formal process for regular meetings between the School Committee and a mandated student advisory body.

items.title: Condolences and Adjournment
items.summary: The Committee expressed condolences to the families of former coach Paul Jacks and Gus A. Sasso.
